title: Pickswise Review 2026: Free Picks, Record Claims, Affiliates
description: Pickswise review, checked 7 Nov 2026: what the free picks cost you, the record claims it makes, who owns it, and how it earns from sportsbook signups.
dek: A large free picks site with a roster of more than 30 named handicappers. You pay nothing for the picks. Pickswise is paid when readers sign up with the sportsbooks, prediction markets and fantasy apps it promotes, and we found no full record of every pick.

status.label: Not verified
status.note: Watchdog has not graded a full, time stamped record for Pickswise or any of its handicappers. This page reports what we could check and labels everything else.

short_answer: Pickswise is a real, established media business. It names an operator and an office address, lists its handicappers by name with short bios, and posts picks with the odds before games start. In that sense it is legitimate, and it does not charge for picks.

Free is not the same as proven. The only performance number we found was a single NFL line saying last season's picks made "+82.1 units with 30 winning selections," with no losses, prices or full log shown. The site's own terms call the picks entertainment and say past results are "advisory" and may contain small errors.

The business model matters more than any price. Pickswise says it is paid when a reader clicks through and opens an account with an operator, and every pick card carries a bet button. Use it as free reading, not as a record, and track any pick you follow yourself.
pricing_intro: Pickswise does not sell picks. On 7 Nov 2026 we found no subscription, VIP or paid tier on the pages we opened, and the terms say referral revenue "enables us to keep all of our products free." Your real cost is what you bet.
pricing: Daily picks on pickswise.com (NFL, college football, NBA, NHL, college basketball, MLB, soccer and more)
Free and optional, per the terms
None found on any page we opened
guarantee: There is no guarantee because there is nothing to buy. The terms go the other way: picks are "for entertainment purposes only" and no liability "financial or otherwise" is assumed by Pickswise, Playhill US, Inc. or any connected company.

The same section says results of previous picks are provided "on an advisory basis only" and that small human errors may occur in recording them. A bettor should read that as the site declining to stand behind its own reported results.

claims_note: The NFL figure gives units and a count of winners but no losses, no stake size, no prices and no list of the bets. Thirty winners alone does not tell you the win rate, and "the picks & predictions" is not defined, so we cannot say which picks the number covers.
Every pick carries a confidence label such as Max, High, Medium or Fair. We found no page showing how each label has performed over time.
record: Pickswise posts picks before kickoff with the team, the market and the odds, and each handicapper profile lists that handicapper's latest picks. We did not find a win and loss record, units or ROI on the profile we opened, and we found no full results log on any page we could open.
So a reader can see what was picked, but cannot easily check how a handicapper or the site has done across a full season. The one season figure we found is chosen and summarized by the seller.

our_data.text: Watchdog grades picks captured from public posts before the game starts. In this edition no Pickswise handicapper is matched to a Watchdog graded record, so we make no claim about how these handicappers perform.
our_data.context: Free picks still cost money when they lose: at standard -110 odds a bettor needs about 52.4% to break even. On the Watchdog board on 7 Nov 2026, {{over60}} of {{established}} established accounts (100 or more graded picks) were at 60% or better, and the median established account won {{median_win}}% of its picks.

customers_intro: Most independent feedback on Pickswise sits on its App Store page. Trustpilot had no reviews, BBB returned no profile, and forum discussion was thin. Below is what we read and how much weight it carries.

customers.text: Forum feedback is light and mostly about the free content. A Covers member in July 2026 said the written analysis had impressed him but that he put little weight on the star ratings, and a reply asked which of its many writers he meant. App Store reviewers below split between praise for the reasoning behind picks and complaints about losses and app problems.
The App Store page showed the app at 3.4 out of 5 from 211 ratings. That is a modest sample for a site of this size, and the ratings mix opinions on the picks with opinions on the app itself.
A three star reviewer said win notifications for parlays did not match his own bet slips, called them "false stats," and said he lost more than he won following the picks over about a year.

A reviewer said the picks favor the bookmakers and that the site gets a cut. Oddly, the review carries a five star rating. Pickswise replied that its picks are "100% free and transparent" and posted before games.
Several reviewers praised the written reasoning behind each pick. One said the picks rated three stars did best for him; another said bettors should do their own research rather than blame the site.

Two reviewers gave two stars over app problems: one said it was unclear which day a prediction was for, the other reported crashes and slow loading. The developer replied in Nov 2025 that stability had been improved.

On Sportsbook Review, a new member asked whether Pickswise picks were reliable. Replies dismissed pick services in general, one calling them "all frauds," but nobody posted results for Pickswise specifically.
Trustpilot showed an unclaimed pickswise.com profile with no reviews. A BBB search for Pickswise returned no results. We found no Reddit thread with a substantial discussion of the site.

conflicts: Pickswise says plainly how it earns. Its terms say "Pickswise receives a payment when a user moves from our website to an operator and signs up for a new account," and its affiliate disclosure says it may receive affiliate compensation when readers sign up or place wagers. The disclosure also says picks are not determined by commercial partners.

On 7 Nov 2026 the homepage promoted signup offers with Pickswise codes for Underdog, Novig, Polymarket, ProphetX, Dabble, Sleeper, Onyx Odds, ParlayPlay and EDGE Boost, and the footer links to promo code pages for Caesars, FanDuel, BetMGM, bet365 and DraftKings. Each pick card carries bet buttons. The site also runs online casino reviews and bonus pages.

A referral model pays when you sign up and bet, not when you win. That does not prove anything about the picks, but it is a financial interest a reader should weigh. Pickswise is listed as a brand of Spotlight Sports Group, which also owns Racing Post, and a Spotlight press release says the marketing agency Clever Advertising became an equal partner in scaling Pickswise.
strengths: Completely free picks, with written reasoning for each one.
Named handicappers with bios and their latest picks on a profile page.
Picks show the market and odds and are posted before games start.
The business model is disclosed in the terms and on an affiliate disclosure page.
concerns: No full public record. The one performance figure we found shows units and winners but no losses or bet list.
The terms call picks entertainment and say reported past results are advisory and may contain errors.
Revenue comes from sportsbook, prediction market and casino signups, and every pick has a bet button.
Customer evidence is thin: one app rating sample and no Trustpilot or BBB record.
checklist: Ask for every pick from the last 12 months with the line, the odds and the time it was posted. A season total in a page header is not a record.
Count units, not wins. A count of winning picks without the losses tells you nothing.
Free picks can still cost you. Your losses on the bets are the real price.
Write down each pick yourself the moment you see it, with the line you can actually get.
Give any handicapper a few hundred picks before you call them a winner. Short runs swing hard both ways.
faq: It is a real, established media business with a named operator, a large staff of named handicappers and free picks posted before games. We could not verify that its picks win over time, because we found no full record of every pick.
Yes. On 7 Nov 2026 we found no paid or premium tier. Pickswise says it earns referral payments when readers sign up with sportsbooks and other betting operators.
The contact page and terms name Playhill US, Inc. of Wilmington, Delaware. Spotlight Sports Group lists Pickswise as one of its brands and is the seller of the Pickswise app.
Not yet. No Pickswise handicapper is matched to a Watchdog graded record in this edition. If that changes, this page will say so and show the record.
